## Fund Manager Reverses to Full Conviction on TSLA-SPCX Deal Viability

Institutional sentiment reversals on complex deal math can precede broader consensus shifts; for PM, this reduces perceived near-term deal-break risk in the TSLA-SPCX thesis even absent new structural information, and may foreshadow spread compression if other holders follow.

- A fund manager who previously argued the TSLA-SPCX deal 'math won't pass muster' has publicly reversed to full expectation that the deal will complete.
- Coverage describes the pivot as 'dramatic,' signaling a significant change in institutional deal-risk assessment.
- No new deal terms, regulatory filings, or financial disclosures are cited as the trigger.
- Institutional sentiment on deal valuation is shifting positively based on this single but high-profile pivot.
